sql.query: SELECT tm.id tenantModuleId,m.moduleCode,m.moduleName,tm.status,tm.trialEndsDate,tm.accessStartDate,tm.accessEndDate FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId WHERE tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND m.moduleCode=:moduleCode AND m.isActive=1 AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (tm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR tm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR tm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=tm.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
